resolved_by: Supreme Court in Dixson v. United States, 465 U.S. 482 (1984), which the opinion says the Court granted certiorari to resolve; Congress then enacted § 666
issue: Does the term 'public official' in the general federal bribery statute, 18 U.S.C. § 201, include state and local officials?
quote: The Supreme Court granted certiorari in a case to resolve the split over this issue, Dixson v. United States, 465 U.S. 482 (1984), but once it did, Congress enacted § 666 to “extend federal bribery prohibitions to bribes offered to state and local officials employed by agencies receiving federal funds,” Salinas v. United States, 522 U.S. 52, 58 (1997).
cite: United States v. Hamilton, 46 F.4th 389 (5th Cir. 2022)
